overview.description: Complete bathroom tile installation including floors, walls, showers, and tub surrounds. Includes waterproofing, substrate prep, tile setting, and grouting.

materials.name: Large Format Porcelain (24x48)
materials.durability: Excellent — nearly impervious to water, stains, and scratches

materials.name: Ceramic Wall Tile
materials.durability: Good — suitable for walls, less ideal for high-traffic floors

materials.name: Marble (Carrara, Calacatta)
materials.durability: Good with proper sealing — susceptible to etching from acids

materials.name: Zellige / Handmade-Look Tile
materials.durability: Good — variations in glaze are part of the aesthetic

materials.name: Glass Mosaic
materials.durability: Excellent water resistance, fragile on impact

materials.name: Penny Tile / Hex Mosaic
materials.maintenanceLevel: Medium — more grout lines to maintain

techniques.name: KERDI-BOARD Waterproofing
techniques.description: Schluter KERDI-BOARD foam panels provide a complete waterproof envelope behind tile. Used for shower walls and wet areas.

techniques.name: GO-BOARD Waterproofing
techniques.description: Johns Manville GO-BOARD with cementitious coating. Works with any modified thin-set — no proprietary requirements.

techniques.name: Curbless Shower Build
techniques.description: Linear drain with sloped mortar bed for barrier-free shower entry. Requires precise slope (1/4 inch per foot).

techniques.name: Heated Floor System (DITRA-HEAT)
techniques.description: Schluter DITRA-HEAT electric radiant heating under tile. Provides warm floors in cold Boston winters.

techniques.name: Large Format Tile Installation
techniques.description: Tiles 24x48 or larger require perfectly level substrate, back-buttering, and tile leveling systems for flat, consistent results.

patterns.name: Subway (Running Bond)
patterns.description: Classic 3x6 or 4x8 brick pattern. Timeless, works with any style from traditional to modern.

patterns.name: Herringbone
patterns.description: V-shaped zigzag pattern. Adds visual interest and makes spaces feel larger.

patterns.name: Stacked / Straight Lay
patterns.description: Tiles aligned in a perfect grid. Clean, modern look — requires precise substrate.

patterns.name: Basketweave
patterns.description: Woven pattern alternating horizontal and vertical pairs. Classic, works well on floors.

patterns.name: Hexagon
patterns.description: Six-sided tiles in various sizes. Popular for vintage or eclectic bathrooms.

climateConsiderations: Freeze-thaw cycles can damage improperly waterproofed installations
Heated floors are popular due to cold winters (October-April)
Humidity fluctuations between seasons affect grout and natural stone
Radiant heat systems common in older Boston homes with cold tile floors
popularStyles: Modern spa-like retreats with large format porcelain
Classic subway tile in brownstone renovations
Zellige and handmade-look tiles in Cambridge/Somerville
Marble accents in luxury Back Bay and Beacon Hill homes

brands.name: Daltile
